notes: d1-omni-600M converted to raw LiteRT graphs for the repository litert-community/d1-omni-600M-LiteRT (landed 2026-10-09, DECISIONS #194); source LiquidAI/d1-omni-600M @ 414f8d6438174f5b2133a9c21a478fc42625e308 (LFM Open License v1.0). A decision model: typed questions (noul / choice / score) over a text, an image or an audio clip -> calibrated probabilities; it never generates text. Twelve graphs, each tensor in / tensor out, with the tokenizer, the mel front end, the image tiling / resize / unshuffle and the read-out on the host: decide_<L> for L128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096, the vision tower, the projector and audio_<T> for T501 / 1001 / 2001 / 3001. The shipped decision, tower and audio files carry the lane's fp16-safe norm rewrite (the pre-rewrite decision files collapse in fp16 arithmetic on this phone: every row uniform on OpenCL FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM in round 5, 19 of 20 rows non-finite on the HTP in round 10 leg N3); legs on pre-rewrite or other bytes are not records. This file: d1-omni-600M_decide_L256_fp16.tflite (896315712 B) = the lane's work file d1_omni_work/out/d1omni_decide_L256_f16safe_fp16.tflite (hard link; d1_omni_work/results/ship_manifest.json, round 13), decision graph decide_256 (ids int32 [1,256], prefix float32 [1,256,1024], media / pad / keep_right float32 [1,256], qtype_onehot float32 [1,3] -> scores float32 [1,256]; the host reads the K scores at P + markers); storage in the lane's words 'fp16 FC weights + fp32 table', with the fp16-safe norm rewrite at 36 of 50 norm sites (input x 2^-k, eps x 4^-k, k = 3-5 per site). artifact_sha256 = the manifest's sha256; every phone leg below pushed this file with a sha256 check, phone = Mac = artifact_sha256 (round 10: 'push d1omni_decide_L256_f16safe_fp16.tflite rc=0 bytes 896315712/896315712 sha256 phone=eebf0dcc2bbefa713c71ce64c5b90600497ff5a26edc3a8ecd0116f99725089b mac=eebf0dcc2bbefa713c71ce64c5b90600497ff5a26edc3a8ecd0116f99725089b MATCH in 28s' (d1_omni_work/device/r10/s_graphs.txt); round 9: 'sha256 d1omni_decide_L256_f16safe_fp16.tflite phone=eebf0dcc2bbefa713c71ce64c5b90600497ff5a26edc3a8ecd0116f99725089b mac=eebf0dcc2bbefa713c71ce64c5b90600497ff5a26edc3a8ecd0116f99725089b MATCH' (d1_omni_work/device/r9/s_graphs.txt)).
